glyph.isekai_mahou.zone.desc: Draws a magic circle on the ground where you aim. Every second it applies the effects to everyone inside. Persistent spell. Programmable: after On Hit, it appears where the previous stage hit (e.g. Beam → On Hit → Zone).
glyph.isekai_mahou.wall.desc: Raises a temporary magic wall (5×3) facing you. Anyone touching it receives the effects every second. Programmable: rises at the hit point — right behind the target, cutting off its escape.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rune.desc: Inscribes an almost invisible rune on the targeted ground. When an enemy comes close it unleashes the effects in an area. Persistent spell. Programmable: inscribed at the hit point; with Leap, it lands under the next enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.orbit.desc: Orbs circle around you. Each orb applies the effects when it touches an enemy, then fades. Split creates more orbs.
glyph.isekai_mahou.aura.desc: Wraps you in an aura that applies the effects around you every second, draining 2 mana per second.
glyph.isekai_mahou.pulse.desc: Marks the spot where you stand: every second a wave bursts from it, applying the effects around. Persistent spell. Programmable: marks the point hit by the previous stage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.turret.desc: Creates a floating crystal at the targeted point that fires the spell as a projectile at the nearest enemy. Persistent spell. Programmable: appears at the hit point and every volley that hits triggers On Hit.
glyph.isekai_mahou.conjure.desc: Calls a spirit that follows you and casts the effects on the nearest enemy every 2 seconds. Summon Forge: put a summoning glyph right after it (Summon Golem, Salamander, Undine, Sylph, Guardian Fairy, Living Shadow, Ent) and that creature appears instead of the spirit — the effects that follow are delivered by its attacks, every 2 seconds. Split = how many (up to the creature's limit), Expand = size, Extend = duration, Amplify = strength.
glyph.isekai_mahou.illusion.desc: Creates a shadowy clone of you that lures nearby monsters. When it fades or is destroyed, it explodes, applying the effects. Programmable: the clones appear at the hit point.
glyph.isekai_mahou.seal.desc: Engraves the spell on the weapon in your main hand. Each strong hit applies the effects to the target and uses a charge.
glyph.isekai_mahou.portal.desc: Opens two linked portals: one where you stand and one at the targeted block (up to 64 blocks). Anyone passing through receives the effects.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_b.persistent_: Persistent spell limit (%s): the oldest one faded.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_b.wall_no_spa: There's no room to raise the wall there.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_b.portal_no_t: Aim at a block (up to 64 blocks away) to open the portal exit.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_b.portal_no_s: There's no room for the portal exit there.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_b.portal_too_: The portal exit is too close.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_b.aura_no_man: Your aura faded: you ran out of mana.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_b.seal_no_wea: Hold a weapon in your main hand to seal it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_guard.desc: After Conjuration (or the creature's glyph): the summon guards the spot where it appeared and attacks whoever comes close, instead of following you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_hunt.desc: After Conjuration (or the creature's glyph): the summon chases only the target you were aiming at when casting. With no target in sight, it hunts the next enemy you hit.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_hold.desc: After Conjuration (or the creature's glyph): the summon stays where it appeared and only attacks what is within reach.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_b.order_hunt_: Summons: hunt — hit an enemy to mark the target
hint.isekai_mahou.summon_forge: Your summon obeys the recipe. Press %s to change its order: follow, guard, hunt or stay.
hint.isekai_mahou.summon_forge_tip: Tip: in a spell, put Conjuration and right after it a creature glyph (e.g. Summon Golem). The effects that follow are delivered by its attacks.
